summary: The agent failed because it skipped the pre-flight check and claimed success without running the test suite. The existing excel-formula-injection skill already contains this guidance, but it was not prominent enough to prevent the agent from bypassing it. This update adds a mandatory GATE CHECK at the top, a PRE-COMPLETION CHECKLIST that must be satisfied before claiming done, and strengthens the test-execution requirement to prevent future agents from self-verifying instead of running the actual verifier.
